A step that misses its window never destroys liquidity: the offered\n///      amount goes back to the tiers and that period simply pays no prize.\ncontract HearthPrizePool is\n    IHearthPrizePool,\n    IAutomationCompatible,\n    ZamaEthereumConfig,\n    Ownable2Step,\n    Pausable,\n    ReentrancyGuard\n{\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    /// @dev In tier `t` a saver takes `prizeCount` nested shots, each won with probability\n    ///      `odds * twab / M`, and a tier pays `liquidity * UTILISATION / prizeCount` per shot won.\n    ///      `reconcileEvery` is how many draws the tier's encrypted carry rides along before it is\n    ///      published: a long cadence hides which draw a jackpot was paid in.\n    struct Tier {\n        uint32 prizeCount;\n        uint64 oddsNumerator;\n        uint64 oddsDenominator;\n        uint16 shares;\n        uint16 reconcileEvery;\n    }\n\n    struct Draw {\n        DrawStatus status;\n        euint64 seedHandle;\n        euint8 scaleHandle;\n        ebool nonEmptyHandle;\n        euint64 harvestHandle;\n        uint64 seed;\n        uint8 scaleBits;\n        uint64 harvested;\n        uint64[3] prize;\n        uint64[3] offered;\n    }\n\n    uint8 public constant TIERS = 3;\n\n    /// @notice Share of a tier's liquidity offered per draw, in basis points. Half, so a tier can pay\n    ///         twice its expected number of winners before the vault's clamp bites.\n    uint16 public constant UTILISATION_BPS = 5000;\n\n    /// @notice Largest scale the pool will track. The vault's aggregate is a 128-bit balance-seconds\n    ///         figure, so a range above this could never be reached by any supply the wrapper can mint.\n    uint8 public constant MAX_SCALE_BITS = 120;\n\n    IHearthVault public immutable vault;\n    IERC7984 public immutable asset;\n    uint256 public immutable periodLength;\n    uint256 public immutable firstPeriodAt;\n    uint16 private immutable _totalShares;\n\n    IYieldSource public yieldSource;\n    Tier[3] private _tiers;\n\n    /// @notice Bit length of the range `M = 1 << scaleBits` that draws are run against, tracked so that\n    ///         `M` stays between the aggregate weight and twice it. Each award moves it by at most three.\n    uint8 public scaleBits;\n\n    /// @notice Unreserved liquidity of each tier, in asset base units.\n    uint64[3] public liquidity;\n\n    mapping(uint32 drawId => Draw) private _draws;\n\n    /// @notice Highest draw id closed so far. Draws can be closed out of order inside their windows.\n    uint32 public lastClosedDraw;\n\n    event DrawClosed(\n        uint32 indexed drawId,\n        euint64 seedHandle,\n        euint8 scaleHandle,\n        ebool nonEmptyHandle,\n        euint64 harvestHandle,\n        uint64[3] prize,\n        uint64[3] offered\n    );\n    event DrawAwarded(uint32 indexed drawId, uint64 seed, uint8 scaleBits, uint64 harvested);\n    event DrawEmpty(uint32 indexed drawId, uint64 harvested);\n    event DrawSkipped(uint32 indexed drawId, uint64 harvested);\n    event TierReconciled(uint32 indexed drawId, uint8 indexed tier, uint64 carry);\n    event HarvestFailed(uint32 indexed drawId);\n    event YieldSourceSet(address indexed yieldSource);\n    event Funded(euint64 amount);\n\n    error ZeroAddress();\n    error NotTheVault();\n    error InvalidTier(uint8 tier);\n    error InvalidScaleBits(uint8 scaleBits);\n    error NothingToClose();\n    error AlreadyClosed(uint32 drawId);\n    error WrongStatus(uint32 drawId, DrawStatus status);\n    error CloseWindowClosed(uint32 drawId);\n    error CarryNotPending(uint8 tier);\n    error CannotRescueAsset();\n    error YieldSourceHasNoCode();\n    error RenounceDisabled();\n\n    /// @param vault_ The vault whose schedule this pool follows and whose winnings it backs.\n    /// @param asset_ The confidential token prizes are paid in; must match the vault's asset.\n    /// @param tiers_ Prize count, odds, liquidity shares and reconcile cadence of each tier.\n    /// @param initialScaleBits Expected bit length of the first period's aggregate weight.\n    /// @param owner_ Account allowed to pause draw closing and change the yield source.\n    constructor(\n        IHearthVault vault_,\n        IERC7984 asset_,\n        Tier[3] memory tiers_,\n        uint8 initialScaleBits,\n        address owner_\n    ) Ownable(owner_) {\n        if (address(vault_) == address(0) || address(asset_) == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        if (initialScaleBits == 0 || initialScaleBits > MAX_SCALE_BITS) revert InvalidScaleBits(initialScaleBits);\n\n        vault = vault_;\n        asset = asset_;\n        periodLength = vault_.periodLength();\n        firstPeriodAt = vault_.firstPeriodAt();\n        scaleBits = initialScaleBits;\n\n        uint16 totalShares;\n        for (uint8 tier = 0; tier < TIERS; tier++) {\n            Tier memory config = tiers_[tier];\n            // `prizeCount * oddsNumerator` is the zone multiplier the vault divides by, so it has to fit\n            // the 64-bit field it is published in.\n            if (\n                config.prizeCount == 0 ||\n                config.oddsNumerator == 0 ||\n                config.oddsDenominator < config.oddsNumerator ||\n                config.shares == 0 ||\n                config.reconcileEvery == 0 ||\n                uint256(config.prizeCount) * config.oddsNumerator > type(uint64).max\n            ) revert InvalidTier(tier);\n            _tiers[tier] = config;\n            totalShares += config.shares;\n        }\n        _totalShares = totalShares;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Sets the source of prize liquidity. The zero address disables harvesting.\n    /// @dev Emits YieldSourceSet.\n    function setYieldSource(IYieldSource yieldSource_) external onlyOwner {\n        // A codeless source would make every close revert in the pool's own frame, outside the try.\n        if (address(yieldSource_) != address(0) && address(yieldSource_).code.length == 0) {\n            revert YieldSourceHasNoCode();\n        }\n        yieldSource = yieldSource_;\n        emit YieldSourceSet(address(yieldSource_));\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Stops draws from closing. Awarding, evaluation, reconciliation and withdrawals continue.\n    function pause() external onlyOwner {\n        _pause();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Lets draws close again.\n    function unpause() external onlyOwner {\n        _unpause();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Returns a stray ERC-20 to `to`. The pool never holds public tokens of its own.\n    /// @dev Reverts CannotRescueAsset for the prize asset, so prize liquidity can never be swept.\n    function rescueERC20(IERC20 token, address to) external onlyOwner {\n        if (address(token) == address(asset)) revert CannotRescueAsset();\n        token.safeTransfer(to, token.balanceOf(address(this)));\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Closes the oldest draw still open inside its window.\n    /// @dev Convenience for keepers and the app. Reverts NothingToClose when no draw is closable.\n    function closeDraw() external {\n        uint32 drawId = closableDraw();\n        if (drawId == 0) revert NothingToClose();\n        closeDraw(drawId);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Verifies the decrypted seed, scale, non-empty flag and harvest of a closed draw, books the\n    ///         harvest into the tiers, moves the tracked scale, and opens or abandons the draw.\n    /// @dev `proof` is the KMS signature bundle over the four handles in the order [seed, scale, nonEmpty,\n    ///      harvest]. The harvest is booked before any branch, so yield is never lost. Reverts WrongStatus\n    ///      unless the draw is Closed, and reverts InvalidKMSSignatures if the proof does not verify. An\n    ///      award after the window marks the draw Skipped; a period nobody held a balance in marks it\n    ///      Empty. Both hand the offered liquidity back to the tiers. Emits DrawAwarded, DrawEmpty or\n    ///      DrawSkipped.\n    /// @param scaleCount How many of the vault's five thresholds the aggregate weight cleared.\n    /// @param nonEmpty Whether anyone held a balance during the draw's period.\n    function awardDraw(\n        uint32 drawId,\n        uint64 seed,\n        uint8 scaleCount,\n        bool nonEmpty,\n        uint64 harvested,\n        bytes calldata proof\n    ) external nonReentrant {\n        Draw storage draw = _draws[drawId];\n        if (draw.status != DrawStatus.Closed) revert WrongStatus(drawId, draw.status);\n\n        bytes32[] memory handles = new bytes32[](4);\n        handles[0] = euint64.unwrap(draw.seedHandle);\n        handles[1] = euint8.unwrap(draw.scaleHandle);\n        handles[2] = ebool.unwrap(draw.nonEmptyHandle);\n        handles[3] = euint64.unwrap(draw.harvestHandle);\n        FHE.checkSignatures(handles, abi.encode(seed, scaleCount, nonEmpty, harvested), proof);\n\n        _distribute(harvested);\n        // An empty period measures nothing, so the bracket holds; otherwise an idle pool would decay\n        // its scale and hand the first returning savers every prize until it climbed back.\n        if (nonEmpty) scaleBits = _nextScaleBits(scaleCount);\n\n        draw.seed = seed;\n        draw.scaleBits = scaleBits;\n        draw.harvested = harvested;\n\n        if (_currentPeriod() > drawId + 2) {\n            _returnOffered(drawId, draw);\n            draw.status = DrawStatus.Skipped;\n            emit DrawSkipped(drawId, harvested);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        if (!nonEmpty) {\n            _returnOffered(drawId, draw);\n            draw.status = DrawStatus.Empty;\n            emit DrawEmpty(drawId, harvested);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        draw.status = DrawStatus.Awarded;\n        emit DrawAwarded(drawId, seed, draw.scaleBits, harvested);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Books a tier's decrypted carry back into its plaintext liquidity.\n    /// @dev `proof` is the KMS signature bundle over the single carry handle the vault published at its\n    ///      last due finalization. Reverts CarryNotPending when that tier has nothing awaiting\n    ///      reconciliation, which is also the replay guard, InvalidTier above the last tier, and\n    ///      InvalidKMSSignatures if the proof does not verify. Emits TierReconciled.\n    function reconcile(uint8 tier, uint64 carry, bytes calldata proof) external nonReentrant {\n        if (tier >= TIERS) revert InvalidTier(tier);\n        (euint64 handle, uint32 publishedAt, bool pending) = vault.publishedCarry(tier);\n        if (!pending) revert CarryNotPending(tier);\n\n        bytes32[] memory handles = new bytes32[](1);\n        handles[0] = euint64.unwrap(handle);\n        FHE.checkSignatures(handles, abi.encode(carry), proof);\n\n        vault.consumeCarry(tier, carry);\n        liquidity[tier] += carry;\n\n        emit TierReconciled(publishedAt, tier, carry);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IHearthPrizePool\n    /// @dev Reverts NotTheVault for any other caller. Emits Funded.\n    function fund(euint64 amount) external nonReentrant returns (euint64 sent) {\n        if (msg.sender != address(vault)) revert NotTheVault();\n        FHE.allowTransient(amount, address(asset));\n        sent = asset.confidentialTransfer(address(vault), amount);\n        emit Funded(amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IAutomationCompatible\n    /// @dev Closes the draw the upkeep reported rather than whatever is closable now, so a stale\n    ///      `performData` fails on the status check instead of closing an unrelated draw.\n    function performUpkeep(bytes calldata performData) external {\n        closeDraw(abi.decode(performData, (uint32)));\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IAutomationCompatible\n    function checkUpkeep(bytes calldata) external view returns (bool upkeepNeeded, bytes memory performData) {\n        return (canClose(), abi.encode(closableDraw()));\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IHearthPrizePool\n    function drawParams(uint32 drawId) external view returns (DrawParams memory params) {\n        Draw storage draw = _draws[drawId];\n        params.status = draw.status;\n        params.seed = draw.seed;\n        params.scaleBits = draw.scaleBits;\n        params.prize = draw.prize;\n        params.offered = draw.offered;\n        for (uint8 tier = 0; tier < TIERS; tier++) {\n            params.zoneMul[tier] = uint64(_tiers[tier].prizeCount) * _tiers[tier].oddsNumerator;\n            params.zoneDiv[tier] = _tiers[tier].oddsDenominator;\n            params.prizeCount[tier] = _tiers[tier].prizeCount;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Full record of a draw, including the encrypted handles the keeper decrypts.\n    function drawOf(uint32 drawId) external view returns (Draw memory) {\n        return _draws[drawId];\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Prize count, odds, shares and reconcile cadence of `tier`.\n    /// @dev Reverts InvalidTier above the last tier.\n    function tierOf(uint8 tier) external view returns (Tier memory) {\n        if (tier >= TIERS) revert InvalidTier(tier);\n        return _tiers[tier];\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IHearthPrizePool\n    /// @dev Reverts InvalidTier above the last tier.\n    function reconcileEvery(uint8 tier) external view returns (uint16) {\n        if (tier >= TIERS) revert InvalidTier(tier);\n        return _tiers[tier].reconcileEvery;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Last moment at which any step of `drawId` can still land.\n    function windowEndsAt(uint32 drawId) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return Periods.endOf(drawId + 2, firstPeriodAt, periodLength);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The period the chain is in right now.\n    function currentPeriod() external view returns (uint32) {\n        return _currentPeriod();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Closes `drawId`: fixes every tier's prize size and offered liquidity, moves that liquidity\n    ///         into the draw, draws the encrypted seed, asks the vault for the encrypted scale of the\n    ///         period's aggregate weight, and harvests yield.\n    /// @dev Anyone may call, once per draw, from the start of period `drawId + 1` until `closeDeadline`.\n    ///      Reverts CloseWindowClosed outside that span, AlreadyClosed for a draw already past None, and\n    ///      EnforcedPause while paused. A yield source that reverts does not stop the close: the harvest\n    ///      handle is then a trivial zero and HarvestFailed is emitted, so a broken source can never\n    ///      strand a period. The vault marks the scale and the non-empty flag publicly decryptable itself,\n    ///      because it is the contract allowed on them. Costs 3,039,448 homomorphic compute units at a\n    ///      handle depth of 1,109,064 and about 1.23 million gas, measured with the Sepolia tier\n    ///      parameters against the mock coprocessor's price table rather than on Sepolia itself, and\n    ///      independent of how many savers the pool has. Emits DrawClosed.\n    function closeDraw(uint32 drawId) public whenNotPaused nonReentrant {\n        uint32 period = _currentPeriod();\n        if (drawId == 0 || period < drawId + 1 || block.timestamp >= closeDeadline(drawId)) {\n            revert CloseWindowClosed(drawId);\n        }\n\n        Draw storage draw = _draws[drawId];\n        if (draw.status != DrawStatus.None) revert AlreadyClosed(drawId);\n\n        uint64[3] memory offered;\n        for (uint8 tier = 0; tier < TIERS; tier++) {\n            uint64 available = liquidity[tier];\n            offered[tier] = available;\n            draw.offered[tier] = available;\n            draw.prize[tier] = uint64((uint256(available) * UTILISATION_BPS) / 10_000 / _tiers[tier].prizeCount);\n            liquidity[tier] = 0;\n        }\n        vault.openDraw(drawId, offered);\n\n        euint64 seed = FHE.randEuint64();\n        FHE.allowThis(seed);\n        FHE.makePubliclyDecryptable(seed);\n\n        (euint8 scale, ebool nonEmpty) = vault.scaleFor(drawId, scaleBits);\n\n        euint64 harvestHandle;\n        if (address(yieldSource) == address(0)) {\n            harvestHandle = FHE.asEuint64(0);\n        } else {\n            try yieldSource.harvest() returns (euint64 harvested) {\n                harvestHandle = harvested;\n            } catch {\n                harvestHandle = FHE.asEuint64(0);\n                emit HarvestFailed(drawId);\n            }\n        }\n        FHE.allowThis(harvestHandle);\n        FHE.makePubliclyDecryptable(harvestHandle);\n\n        draw.status = DrawStatus.Closed;\n        draw.seedHandle = seed;\n        draw.scaleHandle = scale;\n        draw.nonEmptyHandle = nonEmpty;\n        draw.harvestHandle = harvestHandle;\n        if (drawId > lastClosedDraw) lastClosedDraw = drawId;\n\n        emit DrawClosed(drawId, seed, scale, nonEmpty, harvestHandle, draw.prize, draw.offered);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Disabled: the pool must keep an owner able to change the yield source.\n    function renounceOwnership() public view override onlyOwner {\n        revert RenounceDisabled();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Last moment at which `drawId` may still be closed.\n    /// @dev The first three quarters of the two-period window, so the KMS round trip, the award and every\n    ///      evaluation batch always have at least half a period left after a close.\n    function closeDeadline(uint32 drawId) public view returns (uint256) {\n        return Periods.startOf(drawId + 2, firstPeriodAt, periodLength) + periodLength / 2;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The oldest draw that can still be closed right now, or zero when there is none.\n    /// @dev At any period at most two draws are inside their window, so this scan is two iterations.\n    function closableDraw() public view returns (uint32) {\n        uint32 period = _currentPeriod();\n        if (period < 2) return 0;\n        uint32 oldest = period > 2 ? period - 2 : 1;\n        for (uint32 drawId = oldest; drawId < period; drawId++) {\n            if (_draws[drawId].status == DrawStatus.None && block.timestamp < closeDeadline(drawId)) {\n                return drawId;\n            }\n        }\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice True when a draw is waiting to be closed and the pool is not paused.\n    function canClose() public view returns (bool) {\n        return !paused() && closableDraw() != 0;\n    }\n\n    function _returnOffered(uint32 drawId, Draw storage draw) private {\n        vault.abandonDraw(drawId, draw.offered);\n        for (uint8 tier = 0; tier < TIERS; tier++) {\n            liquidity[tier] += draw.offered[tier];\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _distribute(uint64 harvested) private {\n        if (harvested == 0) return;\n        uint64 assigned;\n        for (uint8 tier = 1; tier < TIERS; tier++) {\n            uint64 share = uint64((uint256(harvested) * _tiers[tier].shares) / _totalShares);\n            liquidity[tier] += share;\n            assigned += share;\n        }\n        // The grand tier takes its share plus the rounding remainder.\n        liquidity[0] += harvested - assigned;\n    }\n\n    /// @dev The vault reports how many of `2^(m-2) .. 2^(m+2)` the aggregate cleared, so `m - 2 + count`\n    ///      is the bit length of the smallest power of two at or above it. A count of zero or five means\n    ///      the aggregate left the bracket, and the scale walks towards it two or three bits per draw.\n    function _nextScaleBits(uint8 count) private view returns (uint8) {\n        int256 next = int256(uint256(scaleBits)) - 2 + int256(uint256(count));\n        if (next < 1) return 1;\n        if (next > int256(uint256(MAX_SCALE_BITS))) return MAX_SCALE_BITS;\n        return uint8(uint256(next));\n    }\n\n    function _currentPeriod() private view returns (uint32) {\n        return Periods.periodOf(block.timestamp, firstPeriodAt, periodLength);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xd18abab6bd630c523b36f9095964d92714d369fd94d35e2d800fc73d3a99289e","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/IAutomationCompatible.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.27;\n\n/// @title IAutomationCompatible\n/// @notice The two functions Chainlink Automation calls on a custom-logic upkeep.\n/// @dev Copied by signature from @chainlink/contracts 1.5.0 so the pool does not pull in that\n///      package and its peer dependencies for two function selectors.\ninterface IAutomationCompatible {\n    /// @notice Simulated off chain by the Automation network; must not be relied on for state.\n    function checkUpkeep(bytes calldata checkData) external returns (bool upkeepNeeded, bytes memory performData);\n\n    /// @notice Executed on chain when `checkUpkeep` reported work. Must validate its own inputs.\n    function performUpkeep(bytes calldata performData) external;\n}\n","keccak256":"0x9e85d5084cb54e56909ffae375cb4525ba3b0a4ff82b06da7967ad34543dd696","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/IHearthPrizePool.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.27;\n\nimport {euint64} from \"@fhevm/solidity/lib/FHE.sol\";\n\n/// @title IHearthPrizePool\n/// @notice What the vault needs from the prize pool: the fixed parameters of an awarded draw, the\n///         reconcile cadence of each tier, and the encrypted transfer that backs credited winnings.\ninterface IHearthPrizePool {\n    /// @dev Order is fixed once deployed: the vault and the app compare against these values by index.\n    ///      Empty is a period in which nobody held a balance, Skipped is an award that landed after the\n    ///      draw's window. Both book the harvest, hand the offered liquidity back and pay nothing.\n    enum DrawStatus {\n        None,\n        Closed,\n        Awarded,\n        Empty,\n        Skipped\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Everything the winner test needs, all public once the draw is awarded. In tier `t` a saver takes\n    ///      `prizeCount[t]` nested shots against the range `M = 1 << scaleBits`: shot `k` is won when\n    ///      `twab * zoneMul[t] > (r + k * M) * zoneDiv[t]`, for the saver's uniform draw `r` in `[0, M)`.\n    ///      Fields are declared widest first so the struct packs without a wasted slot.\n    struct DrawParams {\n        DrawStatus status;\n        uint64[3] prize;\n        uint64[3] offered;\n        uint64[3] zoneMul;\n        uint64[3] zoneDiv;\n        uint32[3] prizeCount;\n        uint64 seed;\n        uint8 scaleBits;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Transfers `amount` of the confidential asset to the vault and returns what was sent.\n    /// @dev Vault only. The vault must have allowed the pool on `amount` in the same transaction.\n    function fund(euint64 amount) external returns (euint64 sent);\n\n    /// @notice The public parameters of `drawId`, meaningful once the draw is awarded.\n    function drawParams(uint32 drawId) external view returns (DrawParams memory);\n\n    /// @notice How many draws pass between two publications of `tier`'s encrypted carry.\n    /// @dev Never zero, so the vault can use it as a modulus.\n    function reconcileEvery(uint8 tier) external view returns (uint16);\n}\n","keccak256":"0xd6434fbaa6b9f8dcd74181b52197d575ffa4fc163866401d54fb6eba99705e3b","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/IHearthVault.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.27;\n\nimport {ebool, euint8, euint64} from \"@fhevm/solidity/lib/FHE.sol\";\n\n/// @title IHearthVault\n/// @notice What the prize pool needs from the vault: the period schedule, the encrypted scale of a\n///         finished period's aggregate weight, the draw's encrypted liquidity, and the per-tier carry.\ninterface IHearthVault {\n    /// @notice Compares the aggregate weight of `period` against `2^(scaleBits-2) .. 2^(scaleBits+2)` and\n    ///         against one, marks both results publicly decryptable and returns them.\n    /// @dev Prize pool only; the period must have ended. The exact aggregate is never published, because\n    ///      two consecutive aggregates and a public transaction timestamp would recover a lone mover's\n    ///      deposit exactly.\n    /// @return count How many of the five thresholds the aggregate cleared, so the pool can move its scale.\n    /// @return nonEmpty Whether anyone held a balance during `period`.\n    function scaleFor(uint32 period, uint8 scaleBits) external returns (euint8 count, ebool nonEmpty);\n\n    /// @notice Moves `offered` plus the tier's encrypted carry into the draw's encrypted liquidity.\n    /// @dev Prize pool only, once per draw.\n    function openDraw(uint32 drawId, uint64[3] calldata offered) external;\n\n    /// @notice Gives a draw that will never pay back: the plaintext `offered` returns to the pool and the\n    ///         encrypted part returns to the tier's carry.\n    /// @dev Prize pool only, for a draw that was opened and is not finalized.\n    function abandonDraw(uint32 drawId, uint64[3] calldata offered) external;\n\n    /// @notice Subtracts a reconciled `amount` from `tier`'s encrypted carry and clears the publication.\n    /// @dev Prize pool only, and only while that tier has a published carry awaiting reconciliation.\n    function consumeCarry(uint8 tier, uint64 amount) external;\n\n    function periodLength() external view returns (uint256);\n\n    function firstPeriodAt() external view returns (uint256);\n\n    /// @notice True once `finalizeDraw` folded `drawId` into the carries, or the draw was abandoned.\n    function finalized(uint32 drawId) external view returns (bool);\n\n    /// @notice The encrypted liquidity of each tier that `drawId` has not paid out.\n    function remainingHandles(uint32 drawId) external view returns (euint64[3] memory);\n\n    /// @notice The carry handle `tier` published, the draw it was published at, and whether it is still\n    ///         waiting to be reconciled.\n    function publishedCarry(uint8 tier) external view returns (euint64 handle, uint32 publishedAt, bool pending);\n}\n","keccak256":"0xe62a68e214e868a1efce04bcbf809e0f77b7c2e4f8a9c88f3c57251bb175d390","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/IYieldSource.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.27;\n\nimport {euint64} from \"@fhevm/solidity/lib/FHE.sol\";\n\n/// @title IYieldSource\n/// @notice A source of prize liquidity for a Hearth prize pool, paid in the pool's confidential asset.\n/// @dev The recipient never books a number the source reports. It books the KMS-verified decryption of the\n///      handle returned here, so a buggy or hostile source cannot create prize liquidity it did not transfer.\n///      Only the savers' balances are private; yield is public in every prize-savings protocol.\ninterface IYieldSource {\n    /// @notice Moves every harvestable unit to the recipient and returns the encrypted amount moved.\n    /// @dev Callable by the recipient only. Returns a handle the recipient is allowed on, so the recipient can\n    ///      mark it publicly decryptable in the same transaction. Returns an encrypted zero without reverting\n    ///      when nothing has accrued, so the recipient's proof always covers a handle.\n    /// @return transferred The encrypted amount the asset reported as transferred.\n    function harvest() external returns (euint64 transferred);\n\n    /// @notice Units of the confidential asset that `harvest` would move right now.\n    function harvestable() external view returns (uint64);\n}\n","keccak256":"0xff55627125f36d25d0344db6dec60854e770b980dd41b284d100442ad7cb9a7d","license":"MIT"},"contracts/libraries/Periods.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.27;\n\n/// @title Periods\n/// @notice Fixed-length draw periods counted from a start timestamp. Period 1 begins at `first`.\n/// @dev A timestamp before `first` belongs to period 0, which never has a draw.\nlibrary Periods {\n    function periodOf(uint256 timestamp, uint256 first, uint256 length) internal pure returns (uint32) {\n        if (timestamp < first) return 0;\n        return uint32((timestamp - first) / length + 1);\n    }\n\n    function startOf(uint32 period, uint256 first, uint256 length) internal pure returns (uint256) {\n        return first + (uint256(period) - 1) * length;\n    }\n\n    function endOf(uint32 period, uint256 first, uint256 length) internal pure returns (uint256) {\n        return first + uint256(period) * length;\n devdoc.details: All liquidity accounting here is plaintext: prize sizes are public, the identities of winners are      not. Every lifecycle step is callable by anyone; the keeper is a convenience, never a privilege.      Prize sizes are fixed at close, before the seed exists, so nothing done after seeing the seed can      change what a win is worth. A step that misses its window never destroys liquidity: the offered      amount goes back to the tiers and that period simply pays no prize.

EnforcedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is paused.

ExpectedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is not paused.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

awardDraw(uint32,uint64,uint8,bool,uint6.details: `proof` is the KMS signature bundle over the four handles in the order [seed, scale, nonEmpty,      harvest]. The harvest is booked before any branch, so yield is never lost. Reverts WrongStatus      unless the draw is Closed, and reverts InvalidKMSSignatures if the proof does not verify. An      award after the window marks the draw Skipped; a period nobody held a balance in marks it      Empty. Both hand the offered liquidity back to the tiers. Emits DrawAwarded, DrawEmpty or      DrawSkipped.

params.nonEmpty: Whether anyone held a balance during the draw's period.
params.scaleCount: How many of the vault's five thresholds the aggregate weight cleared.

closableDraw().details: At any period at most two draws are inside their window, so this scan is two iterations.

closeDeadline(uint32).details: The first three quarters of the two-period window, so the KMS round trip, the award and every      evaluation batch always have at least half a period left after a close.

closeDraw().details: Convenience for keepers and the app. Reverts NothingToClose when no draw is closable.

closeDraw(uint32).details: Anyone may call, once per draw, from the start of period `drawId + 1` until `closeDeadline`.      Reverts CloseWindowClosed outside that span, AlreadyClosed for a draw already past None, and      EnforcedPause while paused. A yield source that reverts does not stop the close: the harvest      handle is then a trivial zero and HarvestFailed is emitted, so a broken source can never      strand a period. The vault marks the scale and the non-empty flag publicly decryptable itself,      because it is the contract allowed on them. Costs 3,039,448 homomorphic compute units at a      handle depth of 1,109,064 and about 1.23 million gas, measured with the Sepolia tier      parameters against the mock coprocessor's price table rather than on Sepolia itself, and      independent of how many savers the pool has. Emits DrawClosed.

params.asset_: The confidential token prizes are paid in; must match the vault's asset.
params.initialScaleBits: Expected bit length of the first period's aggregate weight.
params.owner_: Account allowed to pause draw closing and change the yield source.
params.tiers_: Prize count, odds, liquidity shares and reconcile cadence of each tier.
params.vault_: The vault whose schedule this pool follows and whose winnings it backs.

fund(bytes32).details: Reverts NotTheVault for any other caller. Emits Funded.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

performUpkeep(bytes).details: Closes the draw the upkeep reported rather than whatever is closable now, so a stale      `performData` fails on the status check instead of closing an unrelated draw.

reconcile(uint8,uint64,bytes).details: `proof` is the KMS signature bundle over the single carry handle the vault published at its      last due finalization. Reverts CarryNotPending when that tier has nothing awaiting      reconciliation, which is also the replay guard, InvalidTier above the last tier, and      InvalidKMSSignatures if the proof does not verify. Emits TierReconciled.

reconcileEvery(uint8).details: Reverts InvalidTier above the last tier.

rescueERC20(address,address).details: Reverts CannotRescueAsset for the prize asset, so prize liquidity can never be swept.

tierOf(uint8).details: Reverts InvalidTier above the last tier.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

devdoc.title: HearthPrizePool

InvalidKMSSignatures().notice: Returned if the returned KMS signatures are not valid.

ZamaProtocolUnsupported().notice: Returned if the Zama protocol is not supported on the current chain

PublicDecryptionVerified(bytes32[],bytes.notice: This event is emitted when public decryption has been successfully verified.

MAX_SCALE_BITS().notice: Largest scale the pool will track. The vault's aggregate is a 128-bit balance-seconds         figure, so a range above this could never be reached by any supply the wrapper can mint.

UTILISATION_BPS().notice: Share of a tier's liquidity offered per draw, in basis points. Half, so a tier can pay         twice its expected number of winners before the vault's clamp bites.

awardDraw(uint32,uint64,uint8,bool,uint6.notice: Verifies the decrypted seed, scale, non-empty flag and harvest of a closed draw, books the         harvest into the tiers, moves the tracked scale, and opens or abandons the draw.

canClose().notice: True when a draw is waiting to be closed and the pool is not paused.

checkUpkeep(bytes).notice: Simulated off chain by the Automation network; must not be relied on for state.

closableDraw().notice: The oldest draw that can still be closed right now, or zero when there is none.

closeDeadline(uint32).notice: Last moment at which `drawId` may still be closed.

closeDraw().notice: Closes the oldest draw still open inside its window.

closeDraw(uint32).notice: Closes `drawId`: fixes every tier's prize size and offered liquidity, moves that liquidity         into the draw, draws the encrypted seed, asks the vault for the encrypted scale of the         period's aggregate weight, and harvests yield.

currentPeriod().notice: The period the chain is in right now.

drawOf(uint32).notice: Full record of a draw, including the encrypted handles the keeper decrypts.

drawParams(uint32).notice: The public parameters of `drawId`, meaningful once the draw is awarded.

fund(bytes32).notice: Transfers `amount` of the confidential asset to the vault and returns what was sent.

lastClosedDraw().notice: Highest draw id closed so far. Draws can be closed out of order inside their windows.

liquidity(uint256).notice: Unreserved liquidity of each tier, in asset base units.

pause().notice: Stops draws from closing. Awarding, evaluation, reconciliation and withdrawals continue.

performUpkeep(bytes).notice: Executed on chain when `checkUpkeep` reported work. Must validate its own inputs.

reconcile(uint8,uint64,bytes).notice: Books a tier's decrypted carry back into its plaintext liquidity.

reconcileEvery(uint8).notice: How many draws pass between two publications of `tier`'s encrypted carry.

renounceOwnership().notice: Disabled: the pool must keep an owner able to change the yield source.

rescueERC20(address,address).notice: Returns a stray ERC-20 to `to`. The pool never holds public tokens of its own.

scaleBits().notice: Bit length of the range `M = 1 << scaleBits` that draws are run against, tracked so that         `M` stays between the aggregate weight and twice it. Each award moves it by at most three.

setYieldSource(address).notice: Sets the source of prize liquidity. The zero address disables harvesting.

tierOf(uint8).notice: Prize count, odds, shares and reconcile cadence of `tier`.

windowEndsAt(uint32).notice: Last moment at which any step of `drawId` can still land.

userdoc.notice: Runs the draw schedule: fixes prize sizes, moves tier liquidity into a draw, draws the encrypted         random seed, verifies the decrypted seed, scale, non-empty flag and harvest, backs the winnings         the vault credits, and books each tier's reconciled carry back into plaintext liquidity.
